title: 「It is fair to say that ...」作出合理而審慎的判斷
titleZh: 「It is fair to say that ...」作出合理而審慎的判斷
titleEn: Using “It is fair to say that ...”

source.file: Sentence Structure 204 -「It is fair to say that ...」作出合理而審慎的判斷.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: It is fair to say that + complete clause

formulas.formula: It is fair to say that + complete clause

example: It is fair to say that the reform has produced mixed results.
exampleZh: 可以合理地說，這場改革帶來了好壞參半的結果。

examples.en: It is fair to say that the reform has produced mixed results.
examples.zh: 可以合理地說，這場改革帶來了好壞參半的結果。
examples.highlight: It is fair to say that the reform has produced mixed results.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：It is fair to say that + complete clause。

rules.zh: fair 在這裏不是「公平」 在這個句型中，fair 的意思是： ● reasonable 合理的 ● justified 有充分根據的 ● balanced 公允而平衡的 它不是指「公平對待每一個人」。
rules.en: Fair here means reasonable, justified and balanced, not equal treatment of every person.

rules.zh: that 後面必須接完整子句 正確： that 後面的部分必須包含主語和動詞： ● the plan = 主語 ● needs = 動詞 錯誤：
rules.en: Follow that with a complete clause. Correct: It is fair to say that the plan needs more work. Here, the plan is the subject and needs is the verb. Incorrect: It is fair to say that the difficult plan.
examples: It is fair to say that the plan needs more work.
It is fair to say that the difficult plan. ✗

rules.zh: 這個句型會適度減弱語氣 直接說： （這項政策失敗了。） 語氣十分肯定。 使用目標句型： （可以合理地說，這項政策失敗了。） 說話者仍然作出了明確判斷，但表示這是根據現有情況得出的合理結論，而不是不容質疑的絕對 事實。
rules.en: The structure moderately softens a judgement. “The policy failed” sounds highly certain. “It is fair to say that the policy failed” still makes a clear judgement but presents it as a reasonable conclusion from the available evidence rather than an indisputable fact.
examples: It is fair to say that the policy failed.

rules.zh: 可以表達正面、負面或好壞參半的評價 正面： 負面： 好壞參半：
rules.en: The structure can introduce a positive, negative or mixed evaluation. Positive: It is fair to say that the event was successful. Negative: It is fair to say that the company responded too slowly. Mixed: It is fair to say that the app is convenient but not perfect.
examples: It is fair to say that the event was successful.
It is fair to say that the company responded too slowly.
It is fair to say that the app is convenient but not perfect.

rules.zh: 不要寫成 fairly to say 正確： 錯誤： 這裏需要形容詞 fair，而不是副詞 fairly。
rules.en: Use fair, not fairly, because the structure requires the adjective fair rather than the adverb fairly. Correct: It is fair to say that .... Incorrect: It is fairly to say that ....
examples: It is fair to say that...
It is fairly to say that... ✗

rules.zh: 判斷應該有一定根據 這個句型適合用來總結： ● 數據或調查結果 ● 多項觀察 ● 正反兩面的證據 ● 一段事件的整體表現 ● 一項政策或計劃的成效 它不適合用來包裝毫無根據的猜測。
rules.en: Base the judgement on evidence. The structure can summarise data or survey results, several observations, evidence on both sides, the overall performance of a series of events, or the effectiveness of a policy or plan. Do not use it to disguise an unsupported guess.

benefits.zh: 讓判斷聽起來更平衡 這個句型能讓你提出明確看法，同時避免顯得過分武斷或自以為是。 你不是說自己的判斷一定正確，而是表示根據目前的資料，這個結論是合理的。
benefits.en: It makes a judgement sound more balanced. You can state a clear view without sounding overly dogmatic or self-important: the wording presents the conclusion as reasonable on the available information, not as unquestionably correct.

benefits.zh: 幫助你控制說法的強弱 直接陳述有時會令人以為你正在宣稱一件事是絕對事實。 使用 It is fair to say that...，可以清楚表示這是一個有根據的判斷，而不是百分之百確定的事 實。 比較： （這項改革帶來了好壞參半的結果。） （可以合理地說，這項改革帶來了好壞參半的結果。） 第二句的語氣較審慎，也更能容納不同觀點。
benefits.en: It helps control claim strength. A direct statement can sound like an absolute fact, whereas “It is fair to say that ...” marks a well-founded judgement that is not one hundred per cent certain. Compare: The reform has produced mixed results. It is fair to say that the reform has produced mixed results. The second version is more cautious and leaves room for other views.

benefits.zh: 容易總結多項證據 當你已經列出數據、例子或正反理據後，可以使用這個句型作出整體結論。 例如： 這樣可以把前面的多項資料自然地收束成一個清晰判斷。
benefits.en: It makes it easy to summarise several pieces of evidence. After listing data, examples or arguments on both sides, use the structure for an overall conclusion: Attendance increased, costs fell and customer feedback improved. It is fair to say that the programme was successful. This neatly draws the preceding evidence into one clear judgement.

benefits.zh: 適合處理好壞參半的情況 很多政策、產品和決定並非完全成功或完全失敗。 這個句型能幫助你作出較有分寸的評價：
benefits.en: It suits mixed outcomes. Many policies, products and decisions are neither wholly successful nor wholly unsuccessful, so the structure supports a measured evaluation: It is fair to say that the policy created new opportunities but also caused practical difficulties.

benefits.zh: 適合用於作文、報告、簡報和討論 這是一個現成的表達框架，能幫助你： ● 在議論文中提出整體判斷； ● 在報告中總結結果； ● 在簡報中評價表現； ● 在口語討論中表達審慎意見； ● 避免反覆使用 I think 或 In my opinion。
benefits.en: It provides a ready-made frame for essays, reports, presentations and discussions. Use it to give an overall judgement in an argumentative essay, summarise results in a report, evaluate performance in a presentation, express a cautious opinion in discussion, and avoid repeatedly using I think or In my opinion.

questions.answer: It is fair to say that the recycling scheme has changed some household habits.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項回收計劃改變了部分家庭習慣。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the recycling scheme has changed some household habits.

questions.prompt: The class made clear improvements after receiving the teacher’s comments. It is therefore reasonable to conclude that the feedback helped the class improve.
questions.promptZh: 全班收到老師的評語後有明顯進步。因此，合理的結論是，這些回饋幫助了全班改善。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the teacher’s feedback helped the class improve.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，老師的回饋幫助了全班進步。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the teacher’s feedback helped the class improve.

questions.prompt: The repairs disrupted traffic for several weeks, but the road is now safer and smoother. A balanced assessment is that they caused short-term inconvenience but brought long-term benefits.
questions.promptZh: 維修工程令交通受阻數星期，但道路現在更安全、更平坦。一個平衡的評價是，工程造成短期不便，卻帶來長遠好處。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the road repairs caused short-term inconvenience but brought long-term benefits.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，道路維修工程造成短期不便，但帶來長遠好處。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the road repairs caused short-term inconvenience but brought long-term benefits.

questions.prompt: Reported thefts have fallen since the new security measures were introduced. This supports the reasonable conclusion that the measures have reduced the risk of theft.
questions.promptZh: 自從引入新保安措施後，接報盜竊案件有所下降。這支持一個合理結論：有關措施降低了盜竊風險。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the new security measures have reduced the risk of theft.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，新保安措施降低了盜竊風險。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the new security measures have reduced the risk of theft.

questions.prompt: Customer reviews have become more positive since the new manager arrived. It is therefore reasonable to say that the restaurant’s service has improved.
questions.promptZh: 新經理上任後，顧客評價變得更正面。因此，可以合理地說，餐廳的服務有所改善。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the restaurant’s service has improved since the new manager arrived.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，自從新經理上任後，餐廳的服務有所改善。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the restaurant’s service has improved since the new manager arrived.

questions.prompt: Compared with last year, people from more age groups and communities attended the event. The evidence supports the view that it attracted a wider audience.
questions.promptZh: 與去年相比，來自更多年齡層和社群的人參加了這項活動。證據支持這個看法：活動吸引了更廣泛的參加者。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the event attracted a wider audience than last year.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項活動比去年吸引了更廣泛的參加者。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the event attracted a wider audience than last year.

questions.prompt: Some sectors improved while others faced new difficulties. On balance, the reform has produced mixed results across different sectors.
questions.promptZh: 部分界別有所改善，另一些界別則面對新困難。總體而言，改革在不同界別產生了好壞參半的結果。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the reform has produced mixed results across different sectors.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項改革在不同界別產生了好壞參半的結果。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the reform has produced mixed results across different sectors.

questions.prompt: Staff understood what the organisation wanted to achieve, but many were unsure how it would do so. The fairest summary is that it communicated its goals more clearly than it explained its methods.
questions.promptZh: 員工明白機構想達成甚麼目標，但很多人不清楚它會怎樣實行。最公允的總結是，機構對目標的傳達比對方法的解釋更清晰。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the organisation communicated its goals more clearly than it explained its methods.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這個機構對目標的傳達比對方法的解釋更清晰。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the organisation communicated its goals more clearly than it explained its methods.

questions.prompt: The system completes tasks faster, yet it collects more personal data. A reasonable conclusion is that the technology has increased efficiency while creating new privacy concerns.
questions.promptZh: 這個系統能更快完成工作，卻會收集更多個人資料。一個合理的結論是，這項科技提高了效率，同時帶來新的私隱問題。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the technology has increased efficiency while creating new privacy concerns.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項科技提高了效率，同時帶來新的私隱問題。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the technology has increased efficiency while creating new privacy concerns.

questions.prompt: The teams shared updates regularly, and this appears to have been a major reason for the project’s success. It is reasonable to conclude that the project succeeded because the teams shared information openly.
questions.promptZh: 各團隊定期分享最新情況，而這似乎是項目成功的一個主要原因。合理的結論是，項目成功是因為各團隊公開分享資訊。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the project succeeded because the teams shared information openly.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這個項目之所以成功，是因為各團隊公開分享資訊。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the project succeeded because the teams shared information openly.

questions.prompt: Waste levels have fallen, but recycling rates remain uneven and some districts still lack facilities. A balanced judgement is that the city has made progress in reducing waste, although major challenges remain.
questions.promptZh: 廢物量已有下降，但各區回收率仍不平均，而且部分地區仍缺乏設施。一個平衡的判斷是，城市在減廢方面取得進展，雖然重大挑戰依然存在。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the city has made progress in reducing waste, although major challenges remain.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這座城市在減廢方面取得了進展，雖然重大挑戰依然存在。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the city has made progress in reducing waste, although major challenges remain.

questions.prompt: Given the information available at the time, the decision was understandable; however, it later caused several problems. It is reasonable to describe it as understandable at the time, even though it later caused problems.
questions.promptZh: 考慮到當時掌握的資料，這項決定是可以理解的；然而，它後來造成了數個問題。即使它後來引起問題，把它形容為在當時可以理解仍屬合理。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the decision was understandable at the time, even though it later caused problems.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項決定在當時是可以理解的，即使它後來造成了問題。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the decision was understandable at the time, even though it later caused problems.

questions.prompt: Attendance records show that regular participants improved much more than occasional users. This supports the conclusion that the programme benefited regular participants more than occasional users.
questions.promptZh: 出席紀錄顯示，固定參加者的進步遠多於偶爾參加者。這支持一個結論：這項計劃令固定參加者受益更多。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the programme benefited regular participants more than occasional users.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項計劃令固定參加者比偶爾參加者受益更多。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the programme benefited regular participants more than occasional users.

questions.prompt: The report clearly explains why the problem arose, but offers only general suggestions for dealing with it. The most reasonable summary is that it identifies the main causes without fully explaining how to solve the problem.
questions.promptZh: 報告清楚解釋了問題出現的原因，但只提出一般性的處理建議。最合理的總結是，它指出了主要成因，卻沒有完整說明如何解決問題。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the report identifies the main causes of the problem without fully explaining how to solve it.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這份報告指出了問題的主要成因，但沒有完整說明如何解決它。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the report identifies the main causes of the problem without fully explaining how to solve it.

questions.prompt: More people can now use the services, although improvements vary widely from one district to another. A fair overall judgement is that the policy has improved access to services, but its effects have varied from district to district.
questions.promptZh: 現在有更多人可以使用這些服務，雖然各區的改善程度差異很大。一個公允的整體判斷是，這項政策改善了服務的可及性，但成效因地區而異。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the policy has improved access to services, but its effects have varied from district to district.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項政策改善了服務的可及性，但成效因地區而異。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the policy has improved access to services, but its effects have varied from district to district.

questions.prompt: The first results are encouraging, but they cover only a short period and may not last. The most balanced conclusion is that the reform deserves cautious support because its early gains are promising but not yet secure.
questions.promptZh: 初步結果令人鼓舞，但只涵蓋短時間，而且未必能持續。最平衡的結論是，這項改革值得審慎支持，因為早期成果令人期待，卻尚未穩固。
questions.answer: It is fair to say that the reform deserves cautious support because its early gains are promising but not yet secure.
questions.answerZh: 可以合理地說，這項改革值得審慎支持，因為早期成果令人期待，但尚未穩固。
questions.highlight: It is fair to say that the reform deserves cautious support because its early gains are promising but not yet secure.
